name: AI Video Maker
tagline: Browser-based AI tool for creating videos from text or images, plus image generation and editing.
description: AI Video Maker is an independent browser-based platform for creating videos from text prompts or images and for generating or editing images. Users describe a scene or upload a reference image, choose a model, and generate short video clips in a web workspace without installing software. The platform uses credits: new accounts start with 0 credits, so credits must be added before any generation. Paid monthly or annual subscriptions and one-off credit packs are available. It is aimed at creators, marketers and small teams who need quick AI video and image output.
